newsitem.title: LEBANON: Two Hizbollah fighters killed Thursday in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Two Hizbollah fighters killed Thursday in Lebanon.

text.p: The pro-Iranian Hizbollah movement announced on Saturday the death of two of its guerrillas in clashes with Israeli troops in south Lebanon two days ago.
Three Israeli soldiers were killed and seven wounded in the Thursday night fighting just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.

"With much honour and pride, the Islamic Resistance announces to its people and nation news of two knights who got killed while defending the honour of the Lebanese people," a Hizbollah statement said.

It said Ahmed Mohammed al-Moussawi, 31, and Mehdi Hassan Shamas, 25, were killed while fighting a group of Israeli commandos trying to advance towards the area of Beir ad-Dahr- Daidaba south of the Bekaa Valley.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15 km (nine mile) wide occupation zone they hold in south Lebanon.
